title: Insufficiently Protected Credentials
remediation: Avoid encoding security-sensitive parameters; validate and encrypt if required.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
description: User input reflected in page without encoding.
remediation: Encode all user-supplied output before rendering in HTML.

title: SQL Injection
description: SQL injection via unvalidated query parameter.
remediation: Use parameterized queries for all database operations.

title: Configuration
description: Server version disclosed in HTTP response headers.
remediation: Remove or suppress server version headers in production.
